name: OKF Knowledge Base
description: A general-purpose, agent-managed knowledge base stored as OKF bundles (Markdown + YAML frontmatter). Maintains a two-level derived index (bundle concept index + per-document TOC), serves deterministic concept-anchored search, and exposes 18 okf_* tools natively to the BOS assistant plus a loopback REST bridge for the standalone OKF Knowledge Base app.

toolGroups.name: Knowledge Base
toolGroups.description: A durable, human-readable knowledge base of OKF bundles: concept-anchored search over a derived index, full-document / full-chapter retrieval, ingesting sources into chapters, curating the concept vocabulary, linking, health checks, and importing or exporting bundles.

bundleRoot.description: Absolute BOS VFS path (e.g. /KnowledgeBase, visible in the Files app) under which OKF bundles (directories of Markdown + YAML frontmatter) are stored.

port.description: HTTP port for the loopback REST bridge the OKF Knowledge Base app talks to. 0 lets the OS assign one automatically (recommended — never give this a fixed non-zero default).

maxDepth.description: Ingest reference-crawl depth: how many hops of references to follow beyond the seed source. 0 = seed source only. Overridable per okf_ingest call.

maxWorkers.description: How many references an ingest run ingests concurrently. Real parallelism: agent_delegate is parallel-safe, so sub-agent fan-out in one turn genuinely runs at once. Overridable per okf_ingest call.
